analysis.visual_description: A paper plot hangs on a nail by the parlour door in the yard. The columns are entrances. A stool with a book stands under it. No face.
The book on the stool, open at Costard's pages. The margin has a pin and no strokes. Rain is on the sill. No hand.
A watchet gown on a hook beside the plot, sleeves long, the hem dark from the yard. It is not yet on a body.
